exposure: Location of cesarean incision (upper part of the lower segment vs. traditional lower segment)
finding: Cesarean incision at the upper part of the lower segment resulted in less blood loss, shorter operation time, and less uterine incision tearing compared to traditional lower segment incision.
mod_finding: A cesarean incision at the upper part of the lower segment of the uterus was associated with less blood loss, shorter operation time, and fewer complications compared to the traditional lower segment incision.
